linked_repos.name: SoT-fyc-space
linked_repos.purpose: Design library: the authority for structured gameplay target facts (talents, skills, rules, equipment, relics and related data).
linked_repos.locate: SOT_DESIGNLIB_ROOT, else [roots].designlib_root in the ignored .codex/project/sot-roots.local.toml; its task worktrees are under its own .worktrees/. Stop when neither is set; never guess from a parent directory.
linked_repos.use: Skill sot-designlib (or the sot-designlib role) for reads and writes through its API or repository snapshot; snapshots/rules.json holds the rules verbatim. Create a code worktree with scripts/codex/sot-worktree.ps1 -Action Create -Repository designlib.
linked_repos.rules: Every read records schema_version, the source snapshot or commit and a normalized digest. A production write needs explicit authorization: a dry-run confirmed before any write, per-record readback, then the design library's existing snapshot flow (never hand-edit snapshots/). Publish code with scripts/codex/sot-publish.ps1.

linked_repos.name: ShipOfTheseus-KB
linked_repos.purpose: The one fixed Obsidian vault: narrative, qualitative design, user rulings, ADRs, research and work records.
linked_repos.locate: SOT_KB_ROOT, else [roots].kb_root in the ignored .codex/project/sot-roots.local.toml. There is exactly one vault; never open a task worktree as a second vault or switch the MCP endpoint.
linked_repos.use: Skill sot-kb-write (or the sot-kb role) for MCP search, read, versioned write and readback; 01-Game-Design/rules-catalog.md indexes the rules. After a KB pull request merges, run scripts/codex/sot-worktree.ps1 -Action KbReturn -Repository kb.
linked_repos.rules: Write only on a task branch checked out in the clean vault; never use --ignore-other-worktrees, stash, reset or a second vault. Publish with scripts/codex/sot-publish.ps1. Structured rules follow the design library; the KB rule catalog is for lookup only.
